name: What to Do When Your Fence Panel is Loose

step.name: Step 1
step.text: It's super annoying when your fence panel starts rattling in the wind or sagging, isn't it? A loose fence panel isn't just an eyesore; it can actually compromise the security and look of your whole fence line. First off, you'll want to carefully remove the wobbly panel to get a better look. This lets you properly inspect both the panel itself and the supporting posts. Look closely for any rot, especially where the panel connects to the posts. If you find any exposed timber, it's a good idea to treat it with a wood preservative to prevent future issues. When you're ready to put the panel back, or if you're replacing it, make sure it's level and secure. Using the right clips or brackets, along with exterior-rated fasteners, will help ensure it stays put. A common mistake folks make is not inspecting those hidden post areas, and then the panel just comes loose again. Sometimes, if the damage is widespread or the posts are leaning, it might be time to call in a professional. We're happy to chat about your fence's specific needs and help figure out the best course of action.
